safe_field_policy.source_values_not_accessed: school identifiers, school status/type/name, provider identifiers, contact details, web fields and coordinates

transformation: Outcome-blind postcode-only overlay. Explicitly reject Postfach; parse only a strict terminal positive single house number with an optional one-letter suffix from Strasse; require one full PLZ and normalized Ort; reject every repeated semantic source identity; match an exact existing normalized base street+locality+house+suffix identity with exactly one base locality code; fill blank postcode cells only; preserve every base row and coordinate; add no source-only point.
warning: The source contains contact, identifier and coordinate columns. The overlay validates the pinned schema but accesses only PLZ, Ort and Strasse values and never emits source rows or source coordinates.
